title: The Kingfisher You Almost Miss
caption:
A FLASH OF BLUE, THEN ALMOST HIDDEN. Real perches; no fake fish catch. #WildVox #Kingfisher #Birdwatching

narration_timeline.text: This kingfisher's pointed bill and bright colors stand out in a close view.
narration_timeline.scene: Original source_00 close and clearly identifiable colorful kingfisher on thin branch; do not use distant source_07 here

narration_timeline.text: Another recording reveals vivid blue and orange feathers as the bird changes posture.
narration_timeline.scene: Real orange and blue plumage in independent film

narration_timeline.text: One bird perches on a rounded post; another stays on a branch near a pond.
narration_timeline.scene: Kingfisher on concrete post and one near pond

narration_timeline.text: In separate waterways, leaves and branches make these tiny birds harder to find.
narration_timeline.scene: Two independently filmed distant kingfisher perches within foliage

narration_timeline.text: One distant kingfisher rests quietly on a low branch among the greenery.
narration_timeline.scene: Real distant perched kingfisher with no fish-catch or feeding claim

narration_timeline.text: Even from farther away, its shape and sharp bill help observers recognize a kingfisher.
narration_timeline.scene: Original source_07 distant kingfisher perched among dry reeds; payoff describes spotting from a distance
